back.prompt:
Create one new REAR THREE-QUARTER game view of the exact small leaf hare FOLI in the attached published cutout. The CHARACTER STILL FACES RIGHT. Change the viewpoint around the same character; this is a real dorsal redraw, not the existing chest-facing picture and not a horizontal flip.
VIEW: Camera behind the hare's left shoulder/rear quarter, slightly elevated. Show its rounded warm brown BACK and rump as the dominant torso plane, the back of its head and ear bases, and its green leaf tail on the near rear side. The cream chest and belly must be hidden by the body, not prominently visible. The bent front paws are mostly occluded around the far/right side of the torso. Head/nose continue pointing RIGHT, with only a small partial right profile and a sliver of amber eye at the right edge. Clear occlusion of the face/front establishes this is a rear view.
IDENTITY LOCK: Same small seated upright hare proportions and same warm olive-brown fur, cream muzzle/toes, golden amber eye, tufted fur contour, one upright long leaf-shaped green ear and one long leaf ear swept backward/left, yellow-green ear veins, small leaf tail. Keep exactly TWO leaf ears, not additional ears or head leaves. Keep exactly THREE separate small detached green blade leaves hovering in front/right of its forepaws and face, as in the source; all three readable. No leafy collar, no dagger, no evolved form or new markings.
ART: Same hand-painted cel shading, warm highlights, olive shadows, crisp dark contour, saturated natural greens, upper-left lighting. Match the published Foli design and overall seated pose while rotating the camera to the dorsal side.
OUTPUT: One full-body character on a large square TRUE transparent-alpha PNG, clear margins around both ears, all three detached leaves, tail and feet. Opaque character interiors and clean antialiased edges, completely transparent surroundings. No floor, shadow ellipse, scenery, fog, texture backdrop, colored halo, grid, text, labels or duplicate views.
